title: q is deprecated
summary: The q maintainer states that consumers can almost certainly migrate to native JavaScript promises.

constraints: Preserve fulfillment and rejection timing, chaining, progress behavior where used, error propagation, and cancellation assumptions.

steps.title: Audit Q-specific behavior
steps.instructions: Identify Q-only APIs and semantic assumptions before translating promise chains.

steps.title: Use native promises
steps.instructions: Rewrite Q construction, combinators, and chains with native Promise and async/await equivalents, then remove q.

verification.purpose: Run asynchronous success, rejection, ordering, and repository tests.
